function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The channel (`email` vs `paid_search`) is not randomly assigned — the email campaign was intentionally targeted at loyal and returning customers, who have higher baseline conversion rates. A raw comparison of conversion rates between channels confounds the campaign effect with customer segment differences. To isolate the treatment effect, I stratified by `customer_segment` and computed the stratum-specific conversion rate differences. I then applied weights based on the distribution of segments in the email group to compute a weighted average effect. This adjustment accounts for the imbalance and provides a valid estimate of the campaign's impact on conversion, conditional on segment. The raw difference is invalid due to confounding."}
function.name: resolve_finding
